structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page only explains what each kind of saving is, with no interest rates and no fees, so I can't tell from it whether my bank takes too much. The ones I'd look into are what I already have (פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון) plus government bonds, where 'the state pays the sum back'. I'll ask my son about 'קרן כספית' before the bank.
